# Native Zstd compatibility fixtures

Generated by libzstd 1.5.7 at level 1 through the isolated
[validation oracle](../../../../../tools/validation/portable-zstd/README.md).
The bytes are deterministic synthetic 256 × 256 RGBA tiles, not user images.

For pixel index `i` and channel `c`, the value is 1 for alpha; otherwise it is
`(i * (c * 73 + 1) % 4096) / 1024`. U8 and U16 multiply by 63 and 16383 before
integer conversion. F16 and F32 retain that floating value. Multibyte samples
are little endian and shuffled into one byte plane per pixel-byte position,
matching the existing `.capy` representation. Tests reconstruct the samples and
check old-frame decoding and unchanged tile identities in both encoding modes.
